FN-98VGBBB-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 124
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 124 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Security Regulatory
Board until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise
affect state or local funding.
